meta.description: Shapes a value from 0 to 1 with a curve and scales the result to min and max. Uses alpha when no value is connected

curve.description: The curve drawn on the node: points from 0 to 1 in x and y, sorted by x. Between them it is a smooth curve that never overshoots a point.

value.description: Where the curve is read, from 0 to 1. Unconnected it reads alpha: where along the path, the leaf or the list of paths the input it goes into is read.

min.description: The value at the bottom of the curve (y 0), any number: negative for an angle that turns the other way, or larger than max to turn the curve upside down.

max.description: The value at the top of the curve (y 1), any number.
